notes.title: Dead Reset OUT NOW
notes.content: [p][i]Dead Reset[/i] is an interactive horror where death is not the end, but the key to survival. Guide Cole Mason, a surgeon trapped in a [b]deadly loop[/b], through moral choices, eerie encounters, and fractured alliances. Each choice steers your fate as death unlocks new paths. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="UR8jIHIJIF4;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p][b]Death is Inevitable [/b][/p][p]Master the death-loop to uncover the path to escape. Death is not the end but offers a terrifying new perspective. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Embrace the Horror [/b][/p][p]Immerse yourself in a blood-soaked, interactive narrative with cinematic scares, bloody practical effects and high-stakes choice-driven gameplay that put you at the heart of a relentless sci-fi horror movie.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Choices Matter [/b][/p][p]Steer Cole on a path of Redemption or Damnation in your fight to survive. There are no easy choices as your morality is tested at every turn and your decisions will result in four wildly different endings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pause the Terror [/b][/p][p]Playing to an audience? Enable Streamer Mode, which removes time constraints on choices, letting your viewers guide Cole’s fate and delight in his gruesome deaths.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Who Do You Trust? [/b][/p][p]Build trust or fracture alliances; each bond forged or broken influences your road to survival. View the in-game tracker to check your relationship with other characters, if they are still alive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]A message from the film director, Stewart Sparke...[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]"Dead Reset was designed to get under the skin of the player and deliver relentless scares driven by gruesome practical effects and a time-bending descent into terror. I can't wait for people to dive in and play our blood-drenched, interactive love letter to the horror genre!" [/i][/p][p][/p][p]Developed by Wales Interactive and Dark Rift Horror.[/p][p]Published by Wales Interactive[/p][p]Film production by Dark Rift Horror.[/p]

notes.title: Enter the world of the occult in an interactive thriller!
notes.content:
Enter the world of the occult in Night Book, an interactive thriller!

This update brings minor bug fixes and optimisations.

[b]Night Book is an interactive thriller about an online interpreter who is tricked into reading an ancient book that summons a demon into her home.[/b]

Loralyn works the night shift remotely from her home, live interpreting video calls from English to French and back again. Currently pregnant, with a husband working far away and caring for her mentally ill father, she is desperately trying to keep her family together and safe – but who is she prepared to sacrifice to survive? The fiancé, the baby, her father, or herself?

[previewyoutube=Gi-XJkRbhjw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NEW GAMEPLAY TRAILER | The Isle Tide Hotel
notes.content:
We have a brand new gameplay trailer to see just some of the decisions you'll have to make in The Isle Tide Hotel.

What can you expect? Think Twin Peaks, but British, and with a Wes Anderson vibe. Or a grittier version of Knives Out (but with seven unique endings)! 

[previewyoutube=_lSv_RQkKi8;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as an absent father who must rescue his teenage daughter from an eclectic cult before their final night at The Isle Tide Hotel. Save Eleanor Malone in this eccentric live-action mystery, where every decision affects the story.

Created by brother-sister director-producer combo Harry and Grace Chadwick from Interflix Media, The Isle Tide Hotel takes inspiration from the transformational journey of parenthood. The adventure is transformational in more ways than one, though - each playthrough will uncover unique lore, easter eggs, and hidden scenes to help you uncover the truth of The Isle Tide Hotel.

You don't want to miss our biggest production yet, with a cast including UK icons from shows including Game of Thrones, Call the Midwife and Happy Valley.

[b]The Isle Tide Hotel releases on PC, Epic, Mac, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android on September 12th 2023.[/b]

Cast:
Michael D. Xavier (“Gentleman Jack”, “The Blacklist”) Jemima Rooper (“Flowers in the Attic: The Origin” (2022), “Matriarch” (2022-Hulu), Amit Shah (“Happy Valley", “The Witcher”) Richard Brake (“Game of Thrones”) Georgie Glen (“Call the Midwife”) Tristram Wymark (“Pennyworth”) Jessica Ellerby (“Pennyworth”, “Lovesick”) Joni Ayton-Kent (“The Watch")

notes.title: Release date, trailer and pre-order reveal!
notes.content:
Today we can reveal that the interactive occult thriller Night Book will release on PC, mobile, and all major consoles on July 27! With this news comes a brand new trailer that shows Loralyn, an online interpreter who's tricked into reading an ancient book that summons a demon into her home. 

[h3]Coming July 27[/h3]
Coming to PC, PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and iOS on July 27. 

[h3]Pre-order Discount[/h3]
You can pre-order the game now with 10% discount! Want to wait until launch? Wishlist the game on Steam to show your support and be alerted when the game is live. 

[h3]New trailer[/h3]
Check out the new trailer below...

[previewyoutube=Gi-XJkRbhjw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]More about the game[/h3]
Night Book is full of supernatural terror and suspense as Loralyn, a pregnant translator working from home, is fiendishly tricked into bringing an untold evil into her life. With Loralyn’s husband away and her unwell father in the house with her, players, as Loralyn, must make major decisions that keep the family safe or unwittingly place them in grave danger. Though Night Book features one story, there are multiple paths and endings to discover.

Filmed remotely during lockdown, this entirely live-action title is an acting masterclass, with the close-quarters filming style only ramping up the tension and underlining the occult terror that Loralyn and her family face. Night Book stars an exquisite cast, including Julie Dray (Cyberpunk 2077, Avenue 5) and Colin Salmon (Resident Evil, Arrow, and Die Another Day).

[h3]Features[/h3]
• One story, several different paths and endings.
• From the producers of The Complex and Five dates.
• Co-developed by the studio behind Maid of Sker.
• Starring Julie Dray (Avenue 5) and Colin Salmon (Resident Evil, Mortal Engines).
• A completely live action, interactive movie, filmed remotely during lockdown.
